GenAiPlugin.description: Use this subagent when the user requests shipping rate quotes for a record, or asks for the fastest or cheapest shipping option, based on a package weight.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Determine the Recipient Record ID: use the current Salesforce record ID if available. If none is available, ask the user for a Record ID.
If the Weight is not present in the conversation, ask the user for it. Do not call the shipping rates action until Recipient Record ID and Weight are all known.
Once all three values are known, call the Get Shipping Rates action exactly once.

Determine how to present the results based on what the user asked for: If the user asked for the fastest rate: from the returned entries, find the one with the earliest DeliveryDate. Respond with only that entry (Carrier, ServiceType, Amount, DeliveryDate). Do not list the others. If the user asked for the cheapest rate: from the returned entries, find the one with the lowest Amount. Respond with only that entry (Carrier, ServiceType, Amount, DeliveryDate). Do not list the others. If the user did not specify fastest or cheapest: return all entries returned by the action.
return the relavant rates in conversation like all rates if nothing determine , 0nly fastest if determined.
If the action returns an authorization error, retry the Get Shipping Rates action one time. If it fails again, tell the user the shipping rate lookup failed and ask them to try again shortly.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Get the shipping rate requests tied to a Salesforce record (using the current record as the recipient) and package weight. Supports returning all available rates, or filtering to a single rate when the user asks for the fastest or cheapest option, return in conversation.
